purpose: Give the representation ladder unambiguous scenario expectations, including the two near-misses where the owners previously disagreed.

provenance.not_evidence_of: measured human comprehension, reading speed, or preference

cases.request: What are the three retry settings and their defaults?
cases.shape: a handful of items compared across two attributes
cases.rationale: Three rows on two attributes are read faster inline than in any artifact. Rendering them as a file adds a click and removes nothing.

cases.request: How does the retry loop decide to give up?
cases.rationale: The answer is an algorithm. Pseudocode shows the branch and the termination condition directly.

cases.request: What are the states a request moves through?
cases.shape: a small graph of four states
cases.rationale: A small graph renders natively and stays accessible. An ASCII box diagram misaligns across fonts and breaks for screen readers.

cases.request: Build a view where I can filter the eleven candidate designs and toggle each one's constraints.
cases.shape: interactive state across a many-way comparison
cases.rationale: Filtering and toggling are interaction. No inline rung carries persistent state the reader manipulates.

cases.request: Compare the two cache strategies on hit rate and memory.
cases.shape: short static comparison, two items, two attributes
cases.rationale: NEAR MISS. A comparison request is not automatically an artifact request. Two items on two attributes stay inline; climbing to HTML here produces a file the reader must open to learn four numbers.
cases.guards_against: Treating the word 'compare' as a trigger for the artifact template.

cases.request: I want to compare the two deployment states side by side and switch between them as I read.
cases.shape: state comparison the reader manipulates while reading
cases.rationale: NEAR MISS in the other direction. 'Smallest useful' is not 'smallest'. Switching between states while reading is interaction, and collapsing it to prose removes the thing that was asked for.
cases.guards_against: Over-applying the ladder until every answer becomes a paragraph.

cases.request: Show how the six services depend on each other.
cases.rationale: A list of the six service names and their responsibilities explains ownership but not topology. A reader asking how parts connect is not served by a list of the parts.
cases.guards_against: Substituting a textual responsibility list for an accessible spatial graphic.

invariants.statement: A short answer must not require creating or opening a file.
Decorative ASCII box diagrams are excluded at every rung.
Reaching the HTML rung does not relax any HTML rule: no color-only meaning, offline self-contained delivery, responsive layout, and the full artifact quality pass still apply.
